load_save.about: From boot to Link in control of the save the game continues (title menu: Continue; the load confirmation: Load). Trial 2026-10-20: the cliff save's hearts at 24.5-24.9 s in two runs, five presses each; the fixed A@26.5,A@31,A@35 needs about 50 s. On the cliff A dives off it once the HUD is up, so no rule presses A then.

screen.instructions: What is shown in `screen`, a frame of the video game The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom?

criteria.loading: A black or nearly black screen, possibly with only a small loading indicator or a fade
criteria.title: The title screen (the game logo over a scene), with or without its menu
criteria.menu: A menu or a list of save files to choose from
criteria.dialog: A message or confirmation box waiting for a button press
criteria.cutscene: A scene playing without player control
criteria.gameplay: Link in the world with the game HUD (hearts, map or button icons) visible: the player can move

action.instructions: The goal is to load the saved game and reach the point where the player controls Link. Looking at `screen`, which single input should a player give now?

criteria.press_a: Press A: a title screen, a menu, a save list or a message box is waiting and A confirms the highlighted item
criteria.wait: Give no input: loading (also a loading screen that shows game tips with a "Next tip" button), black, fading, a logo or a scene that will continue by itself
criteria.done: Nothing more is needed: Link is in the world with the HUD and the player can move

hud.instructions: Are Link's heart containers (small red hearts) shown in the top-left corner of `screen`?
